The escalators are out of order between the concourse and platform 12b at Birmingham New Street station until 9 December for essential maintenance.

Alternative routes and step-free access:

Red zone lifts: Fully operational at the B-end for step-free access to the concourse.

Green zone (A-end): Walk down to the front / A-end of the platform to access the green zone, where all escalators and lifts are fully open.
